name: ceramics-admin

dependencies.name: ceramics-api
dependencies.description: Product/stock management and all-orders view + fulfillment-status updates.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Seller sign-in and session; the seller's Thunder role group grants access to admin-only API operations.

description: React SPA admin console for the single store seller: create/edit/publish/delete products, adjust stock quantities, and view/manage all orders and their fulfillment status. Signs the seller in via Thunder (seller role group) and calls ceramics-api for all catalog/stock/order-management operations. Has no shopper-facing catalog, cart, or checkout screens.
